text:
eva: Heads-up — observed a corrupted statefile symlink during the branch reconcile for gpu-pool workspace. Applies started failing when reconcile touched tfstate object keys.
sam: Oof, any error logs?
eva: here's the apply error:
```text
Error: Failed to read state: state file invalid: symlink refers to non-existent object 'statefiles/gpu-pool/2026-03-20T09:12:03Z'
Error: update failed: failed to acquire lock (dynamodb): lease already held by arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/ci-agent (TTL expired)
```
kai: So both a missing S3 object and a lock race. Did gitops do a move/rename of the state key while CI was applying?
eva: yeah reconcile briefly changed the workspace key to include branch suffix (we were testing per-branch TF workspaces) — gitops did an object copy + symlink update, looks like the copy failed mid-update.
sam: Is backend S3 with DynamoDB lock?
eva: yes — s3://redwood-terraform/state/gpu-pool.json + dynamodb tbl terraform-locks
marcos: Quick mitigation: pause the gitops reconcile for infra/*, then manual recover: pull latest good state from s3 versioning and push to workspace key, then unlock the dynamo lock if stuck.
kai: steps I'd run:
```bash
# stop reconcile
kubectl scale deploy/gitops -n infra --replicas=0
# get latest s3 version
aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket redwood-terraform --prefix state/gpu-pool.json
aws s3 cp "s3://redwood-terraform/state/gpu-pool.json?versionId=<good>" ./gpu-pool.tfstate
# push back
terraform state push ./gpu-pool.tfstate # using a locked workstation
# release lock if needed
aws dynamodb delete-item --table-name terraform-locks --key '{"LockID":{"S":"state/gpu-pool"}}'
```

sam: We should not manually delete locks unless we're sure. Better: ttl refresh via a tool or run terraform force-unlock with the lock ID.
eva: noted — I used force-unlock in staging.
marcos: Longer term: stop symlink pattern. Use full object-versioning and atomic rename via S3 copy+bucket versioning or write to a temp key then mv with renaming object key metadata in gitops.
kai: Also add CI gate: if a reconcile changes backend key for a workspace, ensure no active dynamo lock exists and no running applies in last 30m. Reject reconcile otherwise.
sam: Agree. Also add alert for "tfstate object not found" and "dynamo lock TTL flapping" to SRE playbook.
eva: Cost/ops note: this blocked a GPU pool rollout for ~45m, pushed up on-call time and delayed capacity by one morning shift.
marcos: I'll open a small RFC to retire per-branch state symlinks and enable s3 versioning+replicate to eu region. Also propose runbook and a reconciler flag to disable statekey renames.
eva: ping @deploy-bot to re-run any failing applies after we recover.
deploy-bot: Scheduled re-run for 2037832300, will skip workspaces with active locks.
sam: TL;DR action items:
- pause gitops reconcile for infra/* (marcos)
- recover state from s3 version and push (eva)
- run force-unlock or manual unlock (kai + sam)
- add CI gate + alert (marcos)
- RFC to change statekey pattern (marcos)

kai: I'll stay on call for rollback window. Keep updates here.
eva: recovery in progress, will report back.
marcos: noted, thanks.
